name: Positional matchup quadrant: implied team total x opponent FP allowed
census_status: HOMED — weekly published instances held; the quadrant joins a market number (implied total) to a defensive-allowance rate; in-house computation needs a fantasy-points-allowed series GSE does not currently publish (status EXTERNAL-REFERENCE for the allowance side)
stamp_required: implied team total + opponent fantasy points allowed by position, weekly as of capture
stamp_gap: implied totals are archived in-house (line archiver); opponent FP-allowed by position is not an in-house series — the published charts are the held instances
probe_finding: Definition (author @StephenKrupka, weekly QB/RB/WR/TE/DST editions): x = implied team total (market), y = opponent fantasy points per game allowed to the position; green top-right = best matchups (high implied total + weak defense vs the position), pink bottom-left = worst. Data: FantasyPoints + EDS Football. Stamped instance (Week 6 WR edition, read from the chart): best WR spots — Raiders (~45 FP/G allowed, implied ~23), 49ers (~39.5, ~29.5), Jaguars (~41, ~22.5), Bears (~38.5, ~26), Rams (~37, ~32); worst — Chargers (~21.5 allowed, ~17 implied), Broncos (~25.5, ~18.5), Seahawks (~24.5, ~21.5). Role in-engine: a market-anchored matchup prior for the reasoning layer — Layer 1 (the market's implied total) crossed with a position-specific defensive allowance, the exact shape of a Layer 2 matchup read.
